recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量極高，以各成熟階段的顆粒球與核摺疊的單核球系細胞為主，夾雜紅血球系前驅細胞，未見大量母細胞；兒童骨髓骨髓單核球系增生而母細胞未達 20%，符合幼年型骨髓單核球性白血病（JMML）。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate smear with myelomonocytic predominance
Numerous monocytes and promonocyte-like cells with folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation, including myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei
Blasts present but not dominant in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power is markedly cellular and shows a myelomonocytic proliferation. Granulocytic precursors are present at all stages of maturation, admixed with numerous monocytes and monocytic precursors with folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm, and scattered erythroid precursors. Blasts are present but do not predominate in this field. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative/myelodysplastic process with monocytic proliferation, supportive of juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in a child; a formal differential count is needed to confirm blasts are below 20%.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: AML shows sheets of monoblasts and promonocytes accounting for at least 20% of cells, rather than maturing granulocytes with monocytes.
CML marrow is similarly hypercellular but shows a granulocytic predominance with basophils and dwarf megakaryocytes, and requires BCR::ABL1.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow granulocytic and monocytic hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia lacks dysplasia and the persistent peripheral monocytosis and genetic abnormalities of JMML; morphology alone may not separate them.
